question: An _____ is a cricket shot where the batsman swings the bat vertically and hits the ball along the ground. The ball is hit between cover and mid-off.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Off drive**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• An **Off drive** is a cricket shot where the batsman swings the bat vertically and hits the ball along the ground.
 
• The ball is hit between cover and mid-off.
